scope: MCP-visible tools plus hidden server-internal technical tool facades; implementation modules remain excluded

public_mcp_tools.description: MCP-callable tools exposed by the public profile

authorized_mcp_tools.description: MCP-callable tools exposed only through authenticated/authorized profile surfaces and intended for model/agent use

restricted_core_tools.description: No active restricted-core MCP tools after Stage 5; code_sample_js is represented in authorized_mcp_tools with an authorized facade.
restricted_core_tools.stage5_note: code_sample_js is now represented only in authorized_mcp_tools because runtime loader exposes it through tools/public/code_sample_js under authorized group.

internal_runtime_tools.description: Hidden technical tool facades and governance/status helpers reserved for server-internal use; they must not appear in MCP tools/list or connector-visible surfaces.

auth_legacy_retirement_status.name: auth_legacy_retirement_status
auth_legacy_retirement_status.description: Read-only status for retired access/bearer TEST MCP runtime targets; replaces four precutover auth transition/bearer guard tools in active surface.

access_bearer_retirement.preferred_stage4_path: replace four precutover tools with one auth_legacy_retirement_status tool, then hard-remove after stabilization if operator approves

source_layout.flat_tools_rule: A file in tools/*.js is not MCP-callable unless loaded through core descriptors, tools/public facade, or tools/authorized facade. Root-only legacy auth tools are retained as retired/precutover implementation artifacts, not current surface.

sessionless_ready_review.notes: Root spec reviewed for sessionless-ready workflow posture; stable connector route remains unchanged and sessionless activation/migration remain separate explicit operator stages. The hidden /mcp/sessionless route is a historical transition route, not the final target architecture, and it is now retired from active repo runtime and confirmed absent on live OAuth21 3008 after the controlled restart.
